name: pireel
description: Preview Pireel's latest agent workflows for editing multi-source videos and creating finished cuts.

defaultPrompt: Turn these source clips into three distinct short-video cuts
Clean up this talking-head and add purposeful graphics
Build a product montage with captions and a clear visual rhythm
interface.shortDescription: Try the latest Pireel agent workflows
interface.longDescription: This preview channel connects to Pireel's isolated preview environment and ships the latest workflow before public release. It supports local media import, transcript editing, montage and multi-output variants, designed graphics, captions, themes, framing and local export. Edits remain visible and editable in Pireel Studio Preview.
